answer: Farming becomes a glacier bet on surviving 76 epochs of grading, and every zenith settlement recomputes the vault schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 76 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
